text:
alex: OK team, need to finalize localized demo assets for the Datadog marketplace tile — copy, screenshots, and short demo video. Goal: JP + FR + EN. spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/marketplace-localization (edit). Deadline next WED EOD.

maya: Ack. I can own JP copy + voiceover. Do we have translations or should we get an agency?

simon: We have a lightweight internal translation pool but quality for technical UI copy is hit-or-miss. Recommend small agency for FR, internal for JP. Budget ok? :thinking: 

alex: Budget approved up to $2k for FR agency. JP internal + review by @vera.

vera: happy to review JP UI strings. Also need static dashboard screenshots at 1600x900 and a short GIF of trace flow. Who can run the scenario?

jia: I can script the demo; will use simon's test project with OTLP traces and a dd-integration sample. Need creds for a sandbox account. @alex can you create a demo key with limited scope?

alex: created limited demo key (see deploy-bot). key expires in 30 days. Link: https://tiny.redwood/demo-keys

deploy-bot: demo-key created by alex — id rk_demo_1759 — expires 2026-04-18. :white_check_mark:

simon: For screenshots let's pin the sampler to deterministic trace ids so the GIF doesn't flakily fail. I'll add a small script:
```
python replay_traces.py --seed=42 --duration=30s --service=redwood-demo
```

maya: For voiceover, do we want subtitles in the localized language or English captions? Subtitles preferred.

vera: Subtitles yes. Also make sure code snippets are localized only for labels, not for commands.

alex: Good. Deliverables list: 3 localized copy files, 3 voiceover audio files, 3 subtitle SRTs, 3 screenshot packs, 3 GIFs (15s), one 90s demo video, packaging README for marketplace. Assign: maya (JP copy + audio), simon (screenshot + trace scripts + FR screenshot), jia (demo video + packaging), vera (review + QA). I'll coordinate FR agency.

maya: timeline: JP copy by Tue EOD, audio by Thu.

simon: I'll produce screenshots + gif by Wed morning, trace script pushed to repo `marketplace/demo-scripts`.

jia: video rough cut by Thu, final by Fri. Need voiceover files from maya and agency.

alex: FYI we need to include OpenTelemetry quickstart snippet in the README. Use this minimal snippet:
```
# OTLP exporter minimal
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
```
Keep it language-agnostic.

vera: Also add a note about sampling — our recommended starter is parent-based + 0.2 default for noisy workloads.

simon: Noted. I'll include a `tracing-readme.md` with recommended sampling config and a Datadog dashboard JSON export.

maya: For FR agency, I'm looping in contact: julien@example.co — will share brief + target turnaround 4 days.

alex: Cool. I'll block a publish freeze window next Tue 09:00-11:00 PT for the marketplace push. No press during embargo until marketing signoff.

jia: Any acceptance criteria for QA? e.g., demo video shows trace spans with correct service names, screenshots have no PII.

vera: QA: verify (1) screenshots match expected dashboard state, (2) trace timeline matches the script, (3) captions synced, (4) asset filenames follow `dd_tile_<lang>_<asset_type>_v1.zip`.

simon: I'll create a checklist PR in `marketplace/ops` with the QA steps.

alex: Thanks. If anything slips, ping here or @ops-channel. Closing loop — next check-in Wed 10AM PT.

maya: 👍

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1759999700 (Wed 10:00 PT) to channel partnerships.
